about: Test vectors for a libzync SwiftSync-hints verifier (docs/libzync/SWIFTSYNC_PROOFS.md §5). Each case gives the verifier arguments (swiftsync-verify syntax) and the exit code a correct verifier must give: 0 OK, 2 DEMO, 1 FAIL. No genesis-anchored receipt exists yet, so no case expects 0. The receipts are from the round-4 signet image c3501ac900743bbc911c8f6dedcd71f1ee53fe4bea4f1cbc9726324478e63dae and start from a supplied state at 2,500 (r4_anchor_2500.json).

cases.name: demo_receipt
cases.description: The real round-4 signet proof of 2,501..2,600 from a supplied 2,500 state, with its hints file: every check passes, verdict DEMO.

cases.name: demo_bundle
cases.description: The same proof as a bundle: header matches the verified result.

cases.name: no_anchor
cases.description: The same proof checked against genesis: anchor_id is not genesis, FAIL.

cases.name: wrong_image
cases.description: The same proof against the current signet image: a different M, FAIL.

cases.name: wrong_network
cases.description: The same proof with the mainnet parameters (and its image id given): the committed profile says signet, FAIL.

cases.name: early_stop
cases.description: A real receipt that stops at 2,530: height and ss_hints differ from the 2,600 file, FAIL.

cases.name: wrong_file
cases.description: The 2,600 proof against a correct file for a different stop height (3,000), FAIL.

cases.name: trailing_byte
cases.description: The right file with one byte appended: not canonical, FAIL.

cases.name: flipped_bit
cases.description: The right file with one bit flipped in the last list: FAIL.

cases.name: noncanonical_size
cases.description: The right lists with height 1's count written as a 3-byte CompactSize: decodes alike, not canonical, FAIL.

cases.name: bad_version
cases.description: The right file with version 1: FAIL.

cases.name: bundle_header_lies
cases.description: The real bundle with its header's stop height changed to 2,599: FAIL although the receipt is valid.

cases.name: bundle_wrong_file
cases.description: The real bundle with a different hints file: FAIL.
